### God Makes the Seed Grow
Author: Amber Ginter
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/god-makes-the-seed-grow.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 3:7
Points:
- Spiritual immaturity often reveals itself through jealousy, factionalism, and comparison among believers.
- Paul and Apollos were merely servants carrying out assigned tasks rather than the source of spiritual life.
- Comparing personal ministry results or evangelistic giftings causes Christians to lose focus on God's mission.
- Believers are called to faithfully plant and water seeds while trusting God alone to produce eternal fruit.

### God Gives the Growth
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-gives-the-growth
Passage: 1 Corinthians 3:5-9
Points:
- Worldly thinking leads Christians to divide into factions centered on prominent human personalities and talents.
- Spiritual leaders are merely servants carrying out specific roles assigned by God.
- Just as a farmer cannot create crop life, human effort cannot generate spiritual growth apart from the Lord.
- All believers in Christ belong to the same team and are called to work in unity for God's kingdom.
